name: Generate Image
description: Makes an image from a prompt on an image model, optionally starting from an image.

inputs.name: negative_prompt
inputs.label: Negative prompt
inputs.description: What the image should not show. Models that take none ignore it.

inputs.name: width
inputs.label: Width
inputs.description: Unset: the start image's size, else the model's default.

inputs.name: height
inputs.label: Height
inputs.description: Unset: the start image's size, else the model's default.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Start image
inputs.description: Redrawn from instead of from noise. Fitted to the size by covering it and cutting the middle.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.label: Strength
inputs.description: How far to move from the start image: 0 keeps it, 1 ignores it.
